name: anorlondo-stairs-top
description: I-0114 tranche 8 (Thomas, 2026-11-02 05:00: « il faudrait qu'il monte jusqu'en haut de l'escalier », « jusqu'à la dernière marche »): Gamma at the Anor Londo bonfire, facing the great stairs up to the cathedral (as anorlondo-stairs): walked straight up (Z held 20 s; the last step at about 18.5 s at 60, series 39), then still 5 s (series 39 held Z 30 s: a leech enemy at the top caught Gamma after the stairs). Run with the enemies frozen. Read with locomotion-observe.flag (the player's position and terrain response [+0x2DC]: unlock_player_position, unlock_terrain); Times in ms from the motion start.
